question: How do I make a sheet metal flange in Inventor?
answer:
The steps below come from the Inventor 2026 documentation; Inventor 2027.2 is the current release [2], so details may differ slightly.

The Inventor 2026 Help topic "To Create a Sheet Metal Contour Flange" says you can create a contour flange, specify its dimensions, and create a multi-edge contour flange with auto-miter [8]. In that topic, the property panel shows only the parameters needed for the conditions you choose, and when the flange is the base feature, only certain parameters display [8]. You choose a flange direction and set Distance A, which is the length of the contour flange [8]. If the selected file depends on geometry references for placement, such as an edge or face, the Feature Placement group appears. In that case, select the required placement geometry and continue defining the flange parameters [8].

The sources I have are only snippets, so they don't give the exact menu path, the button location, or the full step-by-step sequence. They also don't cover the other flange type, such as an edge-based flange. Autodesk's Inventor Quick Start Guide has a tutorial on adding flanges to sheet metal parts using the exact measurements your assembly needs, but only its description is available to me [7]. For the complete procedure, open the full Help topic [8].
